task_completion.description: Create at least two interior partition walls to define a staff room or cafe prep area.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for at least two distinct wall segments inside the main 100sqm perimeter in the 2D plan or 3D view.

task_completion.description: Furnish the Retail Zone with at least 10 bookcases and one checkout counter.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Count at least 10 bookcase models and one desk/counter object placed within the retail area of the floor plan.

task_completion.description: Furnish the Cafe Zone with at least three tables, six chairs, and one appliance.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Identify at least 3 table objects, 6 chair objects, and 1 kitchen-style appliance (e.g., coffee machine, fridge) in the cafe area.

task_completion.description: Identify areas with at least three text labels.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for at least three distinct text annotations (e.g., 'Retail', 'Cafe', 'Staff Room') on the 2D floor plan.

task_completion.description: Document main aisle widths with at least two dimension lines.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for at least two dimension line objects (lines with arrows and numerical distance values) placed across aisles in the 2D plan.
Look for the 'Save' icon being clicked, a 'Save' dialog box, or the file menu being used to save the .sh3d file.

integrity.description: Agent used the Sweet Home 3D GUI to place objects and draw walls.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots should show the mouse cursor interacting with the furniture catalog, the 2D plan, and the wall drawing tools.

integrity.description: Agent did not simply open a pre-made completed file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory should show the incremental addition of walls, furniture, and labels over time.

integrity.description: Agent did not use terminal commands to bypass the design software.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent's actions should be focused on the Sweet Home 3D application window rather than a command-line interface for the design work.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task starts with 'bookstore_starter.sh3d', which is a 100sqm empty shell stripped of furniture. A passing score requires at least 70 points. The agent must manually place 10+ bookcases, 1 counter, 3+ tables, 6+ chairs, 1+ appliance, 2+ interior walls, 3+ text labels, and 2+ dimension lines. The final file must be saved.
